# Nail Art Studio

> Custom nail art based in Austin, Texas. A calm, private nail studio inside Salon Loft on Bowie St. Gel and Russian manicures, full sets, pedicures, lashes and hand-painted nail art with Vivian and Fami, who take their time until you love your nails.

- Phone: (512) 262-4788
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Clarksville, Tarrytown, West Lake Hills, Rollingwood, Downtown Austin
- Google rating: 5.0 from 14 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/nail-art-studio/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/nail-art-studio/book.html

## Services
- Hand-painted nail art: Florals, stripes, dots and tiny details, painted by hand.
- Gel & Russian manicures: Careful shaping and cuticle work with a glossy gel finish.
- Full sets & refills: Builder gel, Gel-X, Poly/TAP, Dual Forms, acrylic and dip.
- Pedicures: Relaxing pedicures in a quiet, private suite.
- Chrome & cat-eye: Korean cat-eye gels, chrome and shimmer finishes.
- Seasonal & statement sets: Holiday glitter, tortoiseshell, spring tulips and something new each visit.

## About
Nail Art Studio is a private nail suite in Loft 19 at Salon Loft on Bowie St, just west of downtown Austin. It's a small, calm space with one focus: nails you're happy with when you leave. Clients ask for Vivian and Fami by name. Reviewers say they make you feel comfortable and welcome from the moment you walk in, take their time, and will help with suggestions if you don't know what to get. Some have been coming back for over a year. It's a custom nail art atelier, and every set on this site is real work from the studio: hand-painted florals, stripes and dots, Korean cat-eye, chrome, tortoiseshell and holiday glitter. In the studio's own words: "We put lots of love and careful thought into all we do."

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday and Sunday 8 am to 7:15 pm, Saturday 8 am to 1:15 pm.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online through our booking page, or call (512) 262-4788. Clients have been fit in on short notice, so it's worth asking.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: Inside Salon Loft at 311 Bowie St, Loft 19, Austin, TX 78703, just west of downtown.
- Q: Can I bring a nail art idea?
  A: Yes. Bring a photo, or tell us the vibe and we'll suggest something. Florals, stripes, dots, tortoiseshell and seasonal sets are all favorites.
- Q: How much does it cost?
  A: A gel manicure is $50, a regular manicure $30, full sets start at $60 and pedicures at $45. Nail art is $20 to $48. The full price list is on our Services page.
- Q: Do you do lashes?
  A: Yes: Korean lash lift and tint, plus hybrid and single lash sets and refills.
- Q: Can I get my nails and a pedicure at the same time?
  A: Yes. Pedicures are scheduled at the same time as your nails unless you'd rather have it after.
- Q: Who will do my nails?
  A: Vivian or Fami. Both are mentioned by name in our reviews.
